name: adversarial-prompting
description: Use when the user asks to test for prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, system prompt leakage, markdown-image exfiltration, LLM red teaming or OWASP LLM Top 10. Produces a sources-by-sinks threat model and an authorized canary test harness (garak, PyRIT, promptfoo). Not for building defenses (use ai-defense-mechanisms) or web app pentests (use red-team-pentest-methodology).
